content.executive_summary:
- **Identity Confirmed at EPFL/SPC**: EPFL Online People Directory lists Holger Reimerdes as "Senior Scientist" (Maître d'enseignement et de recherche) in unit `EPFL SB SPC-TCV`, office PPB 123, +41 21 693 60 03, holger.reimerdes@epfl.ch; LinkedIn (Plasma physicist at the Swiss Plasma Center (SPC)) and ORCID 0000-0002-9726-1519 corroborate the affiliation. <https://people.epfl.ch/holger.reimerdes>, <https://ch.linkedin.com/in/holger-reimerdes-a383905>, <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9726-1519>
- **Active SNSF Grant (2024+ cut-off)**: SNSF project "Scientific exploitation of the Swiss Fusion Hub divertor upgrade of TCV" runs 01.04.2025 - 31.03.2029 with 1,084,600 CHF awarded; PI Christian Theiler, Holger Reimerdes listed as "Weitere Gesuchstellende" (co-applicant); status "Laufend" (running). <https://data.snf.ch/grants?q=Reimerdes+Holger>
- **No Verifiable Open Positions Found**: A targeted check of SPC Jobs, SPC Postdoc positions, SPC PhD positions, FuseNet, EPFL recruiting portal, and LinkedIn returned no open PhD/research-assistant/postdoc/research-engineer posting explicitly tied to Reimerdes or his subgroup.
- **SNSF PI Status**: Across 7 SNSF records, Reimerdes appears as a co-applicant ("Weitere Gesuchstellende" or "Mitarbeitende"), never as the responsible applicant, in the post-2024 window.
content.identity:
Holger Reimerdes is a Senior Scientist (EPFL MER) in the Swiss Plasma Center (SPC), specifically the TCV Tokamak Physics group, at EPFL. The institutional staff page lists his unit as `EPFL SB SPC-TCV`, his office as PPB 123 (Bâtiment PPB), his phone as +41 21 693 60 03, and his email as holger.reimerdes@epfl.ch. He is also an Honorary Visiting Professor at the University of York (UK), a title awarded in 2020. The EPFL Graph Search entry confirms a brief career path: a short industry stint, a postdoc at Nottingham University, then EPFL SPC with promotion to Senior Scientist in 2014.

Cross-checks:
- EPFL people directory: lists the same email, office, and "Senior Scientist" status. <https://people.epfl.ch/holger.reimerdes>
- LinkedIn profile: title "Plasma physicist at the Swiss Plasma Center (SPC)"; employer Swiss Plasma Center (SPC); location Lausanne; 292 connections. <https://ch.linkedin.com/in/holger-reimerdes-a383905>
- ORCID profile: 0000-0002-9726-1519. <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9726-1519>
- ResearchGate and ScienceDirect author pages corroborate the affiliation. <https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/H-Reimerdes-18332454>, <https://www.sciencedirect.com/author/7003275619/holger-reimerdes>

The known research interests (tokamak operations, divertor closure/optimisation, power exhaust, MHD stability) are an exact match to the topics listed in the request. His 2024-2026 publication on the tightly baffled long-legged divertor in TCV (Reimerdes et al., Nuclear Fusion, accepted 7 May 2026, published 3 June 2026) makes the topical match unambiguous. <https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/1741-4326/ae69f9/pdf>

No conflicting namesake was found.
content.recent_and_active_funding:
### Active SNSF Grant (announced post-2024-01-01)

The SNSF open data portal was queried for every grant mentioning Reimerdes. The full list of 7 SNSF projects returned is given in the table below; the only project starting on or after 1 January 2024 is the 2025 divertor-upgrade grant. The other six predate 2024 and are listed for completeness.

| SNSF Project | Period | Status | Role | Amount (CHF) | Funder | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scientific exploitation of the Swiss Fusion Hub divertor upgrade of TCV | 01.04.2025 - 31.03.2029 | Laufend (active) | Co-applicant (PI: Christian Theiler) | 1,084,600 | SNSF Project Funding | <https://data.snf.ch/grants?q=Reimerdes+Holger> |
| Advanced plasma physics for fusion | 01.04.2019 - 31.03.2021 | Completed | Co-applicant (PI: J. Graves et al.) | 2,100,000 | SNSF Project Funding | <https://data.snf.ch/grants?q=Reimerdes+Holger> |
| Confinement, stabilisation et chauffage des gaz ionises a haute temperature (plasmas) (Tran) | 2000/1999/1998/1997 rounds | Completed | Mitarbeiter (research staff, not PI) | 1.15M - 1.44M each year | SNSF | <https://data.snf.ch/grants?q=Reimerdes+Holger> |

### Mechanism and Reading

The 2025 SNSF Project Funding grant is the only post-2024 SNSF award in which Reimerdes is named. He is listed as a co-applicant; Christian Theiler is the responsible applicant. The funded work targets the Swiss Fusion Hub TCV divertor upgrade, which is the hardware enabling the divertor closure and power-exhaust optimisation research Reimerdes leads. The grant is the cleanest publicly traceable 2024+ funding trace to Reimerdes.

What I checked but did not find:
- SNSF Starting Grants 2024 - 61 approved projects list: not opened/confirmed; the EPFL Spring 2025 recipients article lists 37 EPFL-led grants but does not name Reimerdes as PI. <https://actu.epfl.ch/news/snsf-project-funding-spring-2025-grant-recipients>
- EPFL internal SPC funding pages and SPC "good news" page: not browsed; <https://www.epfl.ch/research/domains/swiss-plasma-center/good-news-2>
- EUROfusion engineering grants, enabling research projects: the EUROfusion public news page mentions 2027 Engineering Grants opening for application, but does not name Reimerdes. <https://euro-fusion.org/>

Reading: the TCV divertor-upgrade grant is the cleanest 2024+ funding traceable directly to Reimerdes. Anything else (e.g., contributions as named researcher on a EUROfusion work package) is not publicly itemised as "Reimerdes grant".
